New operator Liino is now on rate-up!  Operator Liino is a rising star in the Civilization Band's pop culture scene, widely known as the "Morning Star of La Fantoma". She joined Endfield Industries for personal reasons and currently handles parts of its external communications and public outreach efforts.  

Download now and play Arknights: Endfield for free on the Epic Games Store: https://epic.gm/arknights
